entries.summaryZh: 葡萄牙国王若昂一世率舰队于1415年8月21日攻占北非港口城市休达，从马林王朝手中夺取该城。经过周密准备的进攻之后，城防落入葡萄牙控制，此役通常被视为葡萄牙帝国对外扩张的开端。休达此后长期由葡萄牙统治，直至1668年转归西班牙。
entries.summaryEn: Portuguese forces under King John I captured the North African city of Ceuta from the Marinid Sultanate on 21 August 1415. After a carefully prepared assault the defences fell, and the capture is regarded as the beginning of the Portuguese Empire. Ceuta remained Portuguese until it passed to Spain in 1668.
entries.significanceZh: 它被视为葡萄牙海外扩张与葡萄牙帝国的起点，开启了欧洲势力在非洲沿岸经营据点的阶段。
entries.significanceEn: It is regarded as the starting point of Portuguese overseas expansion and of the Portuguese Empire.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1415年8月21日，与英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级未改动。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 21 August 1415, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 塔博尔山战役发生于1799年4月16日，是拿破仑远征埃及与叙利亚期间法军与奥斯曼军队在塔博尔山附近的一次交战。法军由拿破仑与克莱贝尔指挥，对手是大马士革帕夏阿卜杜拉。克莱贝尔以2000人先抵住奥斯曼军队，拿破仑率2000援军迂回其后方突袭，奥斯曼军溃败。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Mount Tabor was fought on 16 April 1799 between French forces under Napoleon Bonaparte and Jean-Baptiste Kleber and an Ottoman army led by Abdullah Pasha of Damascus, during the siege of Acre. Kleber's 2,000 men held the Ottomans until Bonaparte arrived with 2,000 more and attacked their rear, breaking the Ottoman army.
entries.significanceZh: 此役解除了奥斯曼军队对阿克围城法军的威胁，巩固了法军在叙利亚方向的短暂优势。
entries.significanceEn: It removed the Ottoman relief threat to the French besiegers at Acre and secured Bonaparte's brief hold in Syria.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1799年4月16日，与英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 16 April 1799, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 玉奥战役发生于1884年11月19日，是中法战争期间法军为解救被围困于宣光的法军而进行的一场交战，法军最终获胜。围困宣光的是唐景崧的滇军与刘永福的黑旗军。此役的法军指挥官雅克·迪舍纳上校后来因1895年征服马达加斯加而知名。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Yu Oc was fought on 19 November 1884, a French victory during the Sino-French War. The action was fought to relieve the French garrison of Tuyen Quang, besieged by Tang Jingsong's Yunnan Army and Liu Yongfu's Black Flag Army. The French commander at Yu Oc, Colonel Jacques Duchesne, later distinguished himself in the conquest of Madagascar.
entries.significanceZh: 此役解除了宣光之围，维持了法军在越南北部的前沿存在。
entries.significanceEn: It lifted the siege of Tuyen Quang and preserved the French forward position in northern Vietnam.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1884年11月19日，与中英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中英文维基百科均有该条目，中文条目标题为「玉奥之战」。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级未改动。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 19 November 1884, matching both the Chinese and the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. Wikipedia articles exist in both editions, the Chinese one titled Yu Oc. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 塔里克提之战（又称拉克沙西-坦加迪之战）发生于1565年1月23日，是维贾亚纳加尔帝国与德干诸苏丹国联军之间的一场决定性会战。维贾亚纳加尔一方由阿里亚·罗摩·拉亚统率，战败后帝国逐渐瓦解，德干政治格局随之重组。此役细节因原始史料叙述互相矛盾而难以重建。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Talikota, also called Rakshasi-Tangadi, was a watershed battle fought on 23 January 1565 between the Vijayanagara Empire and an alliance of the Deccan sultanates. The defeat of Aliya Rama Raya led to the empire's eventual collapse and reconfigured Deccan politics. The details are notoriously hard to reconstruct because the primary sources contradict one another.
entries.significanceZh: 此役导致维贾亚纳加尔帝国瓦解，重塑了德干地区此后的政治格局。
entries.significanceEn: It destroyed the Vijayanagara Empire and reshaped the political order of the Deccan.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1565年1月26日，英文维基正文记该战役发生于1月23日，两者相差三日、年份一致，本条采用年精度并保留日期分歧。中文维基百科尚无该条目。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 26 January 1565 while the English article dates the battle to 23 January; the year agrees and the entry keeps year precision, with the day-level difference recorded here. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

yearCorrection.reason: 维基数据 P585 为 ISO 天文纪年 −1178（即公元前1179年），英文维基正文记该战役发生于约公元前1175年；本条采用正文的约数年份并记作 −1175，约数性质在 notes 中说明。

entries.summaryZh: 三角洲之战是古埃及与海上民族之间的一场海战，发生于约公元前1175年，法老拉美西斯三世击退了这次大规模海上入侵。交战地点在尼罗河三角洲东岸与埃及在叙利亚的边界一带，确切位置不明。这场战事记录于拉美西斯三世位于梅迪内特哈布的葬祭庙墙壁上。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of the Delta was a sea battle between Egypt and the Sea Peoples, circa 1175 BC, in which pharaoh Ramesses III repelled a seaborne invasion. The fighting took place on the eastern Nile Delta and near Egypt's Syrian border, though the precise locations are unknown. It is recorded on the walls of his mortuary temple at Medinet Habu.
entries.significanceZh: 此役遏止了海上民族对埃及的入侵，是青铜时代晚期动荡中埃及得以延续的关键一战。
entries.significanceEn: It stopped the Sea Peoples' invasion and is seen as a key reason Egypt survived the Late Bronze Age collapse.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为 ISO 天文纪年 −1178（即公元前1179年），英文维基正文作「约公元前1175年」，本条采用正文年份并记作 −1175（约数）。中文维基百科尚无该条目。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级未改动。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 is the ISO astronomical year -1178 (1179 BCE) while the English article gives circa 1175 BC; the entry adopts the article's approximate year, written -1175. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 拉普拉塔战役发生于1957年1月17日，地点在古巴马埃斯特腊山脉的沿海村庄拉普拉塔，是古巴革命期间的战斗。此役是格拉玛号登陆后起义军的首次战斗，对起义军而言是一次成功：此前他们在阿莱格里亚德皮奥战役中惨败，绝大多数成员被杀、受伤或被俘。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of La Plata was fought on 17 January 1957 at the coastal village of La Plata in Cuba's Sierra Maestra during the Cuban Revolution. It was the rebels' first battle after the Granma landing, a success following their heavy defeat at Alegria de Pio, where most of their force was killed, wounded or captured.
entries.significanceZh: 作为登陆后的首次胜利，它使卡斯特罗的起义军得以在马埃斯特腊山脉立足。
entries.significanceEn: As the first victory after the landing, it allowed Castro's rebels to establish themselves in the Sierra Maestra.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1957年1月17日，与中英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中英文维基百科均有该条目。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级未改动。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 17 January 1957, matching both the Chinese and the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. Wikipedia articles exist in both editions. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 法瑞斯库尔战役发生于1250年4月6日，是第七次十字军东征的最后一场主要交战。由法国国王路易九世统率的十字军与阿尤布王朝图兰沙统率的埃及军队对阵。此前十字军已在曼苏拉战役中受挫，此役中十字军几乎全军覆没，路易九世本人被俘。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Fariskur was the last major engagement of the Seventh Crusade, fought on 6 April 1250 between the Crusaders under King Louis IX of France and Egyptian forces under Turanshah of the Ayyubid dynasty. After their defeat at Al Mansurah in February, the Crusader army was destroyed and Louis IX himself was captured.
entries.significanceZh: 十字军主力在此覆灭、国王被俘，标志着第七次十字军东征的彻底失败。
entries.significanceEn: The destruction of the crusader army and the capture of the king ended the Seventh Crusade in complete failure.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1250年4月6日，与英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 6 April 1250, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 兹库斯之战发生于公元前410年5、6月间，是伯罗奔尼撒战争期间雅典与斯巴达在马尔马拉海沿岸兹库斯附近的一场海战。雅典舰队由阿尔西比亚德斯、色拉西布洛斯和塞拉门尼斯指挥，击溃并摧毁了明达鲁斯统率的斯巴达舰队。此后一年雅典重新控制了赫勒斯滂沿岸多座城市。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Cyzicus took place in May or June 410 BC during the Peloponnesian War. An Athenian fleet commanded by Alcibiades, Thrasybulus and Theramenes routed and destroyed the Spartan fleet under Mindarus. Over the following year Athens recovered control of several cities along the Hellespont, and a Spartan peace offer was rejected.
entries.significanceZh: 此役摧毁斯巴达舰队，使雅典重夺赫勒斯滂的控制权，扭转了战争后期的颓势。
entries.significanceEn: The destruction of the Spartan fleet restored Athenian control of the Hellespont and reversed Athens' fortunes late in the war.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为 ISO 天文纪年 −410，英文维基正文记该战役发生于公元前410年，与本条民用纪年写法 −410（即前410年）一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 is the ISO astronomical year -410 and the English article dates the battle to 410 BC, which this entry writes as -410 under the civil-year convention; year precision is kept. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 梅德韦战役发生于公元43年，地点可能在今英格兰肯特郡的梅德韦河一带，当时属于铁器时代的坎提亚基部落领地。此役是克劳狄乌斯入侵不列颠行动早期的一场交战，罗马军队由将领奥卢斯·普劳提乌斯统率。这场战役的确切位置至今仍未有定论。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of the Medway took place in 43 AD, probably on the River Medway in the lands of the Iron Age Cantiaci tribe, in what is now the English county of Kent. It was an early battle in the Claudian invasion of Britain, led by Aulus Plautius.
entries.significanceZh: 它是罗马征服不列颠过程中的早期关键交战，为罗马在东南不列颠的推进打开通道。
entries.significanceEn: It was an early Roman victory that opened the way for the conquest of south-eastern Britain.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为公元43年（年精度），与英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 43 CE at year precision, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 赫利奥波利斯战役（又称艾因沙姆斯战役）发生于公元640年，是阿拉伯穆斯林军队与拜占庭帝国军队争夺埃及控制权的一场决定性会战。此役之后虽然仍有多次交锋，但拜占庭在埃及的统治实际上已告终结，并为穆斯林征服罗马非洲总督区打开门户。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Heliopolis, also called Ayn Shams, was fought in 640 between Arab Muslim armies and Byzantine forces for control of Egypt. Although skirmishes continued afterwards, the battle effectively decided the fate of Byzantine rule in Egypt and opened the way for the Muslim conquest of the Roman Exarchate of Africa.
entries.significanceZh: 它决定了拜占庭在埃及统治的结局，为穆斯林势力向西推进打开门户。
entries.significanceEn: It sealed the fate of Byzantine Egypt and opened the door to Muslim expansion further west.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为640年7月6日，英文维基正文作640年，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 6 July 640 and the English article gives the year 640, so the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.
